Feather Shear.name: Feather Shear
Feather Shear.description: The user snaps a wingtip and flicks a single shed feather wrapped in a tight blade of compressed air across a room. It deals slashing damage to one target and severs ropes, straps or light cables in its path; held back, the air cushion flattens on impact and only knocks a weapon from a hand. It reaches half a street's width and costs flight feathers that take days to regrow. Strain: moderate.
